items.title: PPL (PPL) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Data Center Power Plant Plans
items.summary: PPL stock has delivered a solid 49.3% total return over the past three years, yet its broader valuation checks currently lean more on the expensive side rather than as a clear bargain. items.title: PPL (PPL) And Blackstone Buy 500 Acres For Potential Data Center Power Plants
items.summary: PPL Corporation (NYSE:PPL) and Blackstone Infrastructure have acquired over 500 acres in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, for potential power plant development. The sites are being evaluated as possible future electricity sources for current and prospective data centers in the region. The project is described as exploratory and has not yet reached a final development decision or timeline.
